_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (see gdd-culture-emergence-and-territory.md); csv_id is the authoritative key for now.
sub_palette: near_eastern (akkadian) lean + north_american (plains) substrate (cross-family fusion, Mesopotamian-leaning)
homeland: Mantua-Sonipi (the Manitou-grassland; the river-temple over the open plain)

blend.lean: near_eastern (akkadian: the alu/bit river-cities, the sangu temple-priesthood, construct-chain toponyms, emphatic gutturals q/kh/sh, triconsonantal roots, -u/-um endings, penultimate stress, SOV agglutinative grammar - the rule/temple/kin register dominant)
blend.substrate: north_american (plains: the horse-nomad bands, the warrior-societies, the medicine-cairn of the open sky, glottalized/ejective consonants, descriptive compounds - the plain/beast/material/staple register beneath)
blend.fusion: Mesopotamian-leaning - a river-city temple-empire of the Two Rivers married to the great-plains horse-nomads who ride its grasslands: the alu-city and the ziggurat enthroned over the buffalo-range, the sangu-scribe and the puhakatu-seer one people. The Akkadian backbone supplies rule, kin, and temple; the Plains substrate supplies the plain, the beast, and the worked material - all run through one Akkadian-shaped sound-law.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_03 (Mesopotamian/Akkadian, civ) x BASE_11 (Plains horse-nomad/Amerindian, clan). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Mesopotamian base = Civilized, Plains base = Clanhold, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Manitour is Civilized (feudal). Concept: 'Manitou' (the great-spirit power) meeting the river-empire - the temple-cities of the Two Rivers fused with the buffalo-hunting horse-nomads of the open plain (an Akkadian-Plains fusion). LEAN = near_eastern (akkadian: the ruling/scribal/temple register, the alu-cities, the bit-ili temples, the construct-chain toponyms, the Akkadian phonology that all words obey); SUBSTRATE = Plains (the grassland, the herds, the worked hide and bone, the horse, the warrior-societies). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Akkadian and Plains registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Akkadian reflexes PRIMARY via hammuran, Plains morphs SECONDARY via family_north_american theonym_sets.plains / numinan), never real gods. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are ENGLISH (no approved foreign term applies for this pairing); conlang forms live in ruler_native/domain_native (Akkadian) for NPC dialogue. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (per-hybrid alignment restriction removed). Deities via the per-family morph method.

phonology.palette: Akkadian lean - emphatic and guttural consonants (q, kh, h, ', sh, ts), triconsonantal roots, a/i/u vowels, -u/-um/-tu endings, penultimate stress, SOV agglutinative grammar - over a Plains substrate: the Plains ejectives and the barred-u and the long descriptive compounds, all bent to the Akkadian inventory. Per the CSV: ejective consonants with deep vowels; grammar is SOV and polysynthetic-agglutinative (the Plains compounding habit carried on Akkadian construct-chains and case-inflection). Theophoric on the Akkadian canon-morphs (Tullaru-, Urlandu-, Numunu-) with Plains medicine-name variants (Torawi-, Kayanta-) as a vision-sign.
phonology.phonotactics: CVC; mimation -um and the Akkadian -u/-tu endings; Plains glottal-stops collapsed to Akkadian ' or dropped; Plains ejectives (p'/t'/k') resolved to the Akkadian emphatics (q, ts) or plain stops; long Plains compounds reshaped as construct-chains; penultimate stress; Bit-/Dur-/Kar- construct toponyms over Plains feature-roots.

sound_changes: Plains ejectives/glottalized stops -> Akkadian inventory: p'>q or p, t'>ts or t, k'>q, glottal-stop ' kept or dropped word-finally
Plains barred-u and free vowels -> Akkadian a/i/u; long descriptive compounds compressed to two-root construct-chains
Akkadian word-shape imposed on every root: penultimate stress, CVC syllables, a final Akkadian -u/-um/-tu on bare roots (puuku>pukku, soni>sunu, toya>tuya)
retain the Akkadian sh/q/kh/emphatics and one audible Plains signature (the -tu/-pu echo, the doubled stop) so both ancestries stay heard; SOV agglutinative grammar throughout
fusion_rules.source_tilt: plain/beast/material/staple words from Plains roots (the substrate works the grass and the herds: soni>sunu grass-plain, puuku>pukku horse, kutsu>kutsu bison, sarii>sarru hide, tunapu>tunappu drymeat); rule/kin/temple/land-tenure/abstract words from Akkadian roots (the ruling register: rabu, mar, ellu, bit, sharru); every chosen root then filtered to one Akkadian-shaped sound-law

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Plains plain/beast/material/staple-roots + Akkadian rule/kin/temple/land-roots, all run through one Akkadian-shaped sound-law (penultimate stress, CVC, -u/-um/-tu, Plains ejectives collapsed to emphatics); portmanteaus mark the blended institutions, bloodline, and the horse-host where the river-temple and the open plain visibly married.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Akkadian ruling/scribal stock keep the 'mar-' (son of) patronymic and theophoric constructs; the Plains horse-stock keep the band/division name and an earned deed/vision-name; the throne fuses both - a sharru who also rode with a band and carries a Bit- house-name over a deed-byname.
morphology.compounding_rule: Akkadian construct-chains (Bit-[god], Dur-[ruler], Kar-[god]) layered over Plains descriptive compounds bent to the Akkadian shape ([quality|animal] + feature: Eka-tuya 'red-mountain', Kutsu-sunu 'bison-plain'): the capital Mantua-Sonipi (Manitou-grassland), Dur-Sharrutu (king's-fort) over the Kutsu-sunu range.

title_ladder.government: feudal (an Akkadian river-temple monarchy whose lords ride with the Plains bands: the sharru and his rubu-kin at the crown, the shaknu-governors over the alu-cities, the akicita warrior-societies and the band-chiefs sworn to the war-host; the sangu-priesthood and the scribal shatammu serve beneath, beside the puhakatu medicine-seers)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Akkadian ladder, ascending, with the Plains substrate co-titles beneath. Hazannu (mayor) barony; Massaru (warden) march; Shaknu (appointed governor) county; Turtanu (commander-in-chief) duchy; Rubu (prince) principality; Sharru (king) kingdom over a Sharrutu; Shar-kishshati (king of the totality) empire over the Kishshatu. The Plains substrate keeps its band-chiefs and warrior-societies beneath the Akkadian crown: the paraibo (band peace-chief) and tekwuniwap (war chief) serve as the shaknu's and turtanu's field-captains, the akicita-society raised as the war-host. The sangu (city-priest) and the puhakatu (medicine-seer) stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Akkadian and Plains registers (allowed); display titles are English.
title_ladder.heir: Mar-Sharri (the king's son / crown prince; the heir)

vassalage.fealty: Ade (Akkadian loyalty-oath) / Puha-tekwa (the Plains sworn word)

title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (no commonly-known foreign term applies for this Akkadian-Plains pairing). The *_native conlang forms (Akkadian) are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Akkadian ruling/scribal stock carry a theophoric given name + mar- patronymic; the Plains horse-stock carry an earned deed/vision-name + band/division; order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Akkadian city-and-temple folk keep theophoric names (X-iddina, Warad-X) on the morphed canon-stems; the Plains riders keep deed-names (Iron Shirt, Spotted Eagle) and society-honors; the throne fuses both - a theophoric sharru who also rode under a war-vision.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Akkadian devotional constructs on the morphed canon-stems: Warad-Tullaru (servant of Tullaru), Tullaru-iddina (Tullaru-gave-me), Numunu-nasir; the Plains side rarely names the powers directly, taking a vision-sign instead (animal, sky, weather - a war-vision under Maraksa).

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Akkadian reflexes PRIMARY (family_near_eastern / hammuran morphs: Tullaru-, Urlandu-, Numunu-), Plains morphs SECONDARY (family_north_american.json theonym_sets.plains, also used by numinan: Torawi, Olanta, Kayanta), never real Mesopotamian/Plains gods. Same shared pantheon, two name-registers for one people. All three alignments; stance follows current alignment (worship_by_alignment). The powers are met both at the built bit-ili/ziggurat of the river-cities AND through the vision-quest (puha) and the medicine-cairn of the open plain.
religion.the_one: Itarnu (< Aeternus; Plains echo Ateruna) - the distant Great-Above, honored not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tullaru (Plains Torawi) - the sun and judgment
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gayandu (Plains Kayanta) - the enduring earth and plain
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Rialtu (Plains Reawina) - the mother, mercy and rain

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Itarnu, Tullaru the just, Urlandu of the sworn war, Rialtu the merciful - at the law-stele of the bit-ili and the medicine-cairn alike; names the Chaotic powers -lemnu (Akkadian evil) or the dread sky-set, warded; the temple-oath and the vision-word bind together
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead and the city-spirits of the bit-ili beside the animal-spirits and the medicine (puha) of place and herd; the great powers invoked at the ziggurat and the vision-bluff situationally
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon (Marakshu the city-burner / war-fire, Tamawi the storm, Lusanta the greed-serpent), and names the Lawful powers - and Itarnu - as the tyrant-gods (Itarnu the Sky-Tyrant) to be defied

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as -lemnu (Akkadian evil) or the dread sky-set, keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marakshu the City-Burner (Plains Maraksa the war-fire); Vacidus -> Bakidu-lemnu the Unmaking (Plains Vachita the void); Lusanto -> Lusanta the Hoard-Serpent.

clergy_ladder.7: Urigallu (chief priest) / Numunu-puhakatu (the band's high seer)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Bit-ili (god-house/temple) of [power] in the river-cities, and the medicine-cairn or vision-bluff of [power] on the open plain: 'the Bit-ili of Tullaru', 'the Medicine-Bluff of Maraksa'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified law-givers and heroes inscribed on the temple-stele of the cities, and the great chiefs and vision-seers who became sky- and animal-spirits; honored at the ziggurat, the burial-scaffold and the medicine-cairn.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tullaru: a winged sun-disc over a law-stele and a buffalo-skull
holy_symbol_motifs.Urlandu: an iron sword crossed with a war-lance
holy_symbol_motifs.Gayandu: the alluvial field beneath the ziggurat, ringed by open grass

banks_patterns.ships: river-barges of the Two Rivers and named war-horses of the plain: 'Pride of the Naru', 'Boat of Tullaru', 'Storm-Runner' (a famed pukku)
banks_patterns.military_units: the sharru's kishru (war-host) and the Plains warrior-societies raised beneath it: 'the Kishru of Mantua', 'the Standard of Urlandu', 'the Dog-Soldier Akicita', 'the Iron-Lance riders'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]' in the cities, the council-lodge or [adjective] tipi on the range: 'The Lapis Cup', 'The Bison and Stele', 'the Red Tipi'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: buried ziggurats and abandoned war-camps: 'the Ziggurat of Dur-[name]', 'the Sunken Ekallu', 'the Ghost-Butte of [chief]', 'the Medicine-Cairn of [name]'
